q: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods

s: the LORD is god of Zion (speaker's people walk in his name forever)
q: but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.

s: remnant of Jacob is gathered by the LORD (lame, driven away and afflicted)
q: I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;

s: remnant of Jacob will become strong nation (that which was cast far off)
q: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation

s: the LORD will reign over remnant of Jacob (on Mount Zion forever)
q: and the LORD will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”

s: tower of the flock is identified with Zion (the hill of the daughter of Zion)
q: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come.

s: Zion will go to Babylon (leaving the city and dwelling in the field)
q: for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon.

s: Babylon is place of rescue of Zion (the LORD will redeem her there from enemies)
q: There you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

s: mountain of the LORD's temple will be exalted above hills (in the latter days)
q: it will be exalted above the hills

s: the LORD will redeem Zion (from the hand of enemies, at Babylon)
q: There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

s: enemies hold Zion (redeemed from their hand)
q: There the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

s: nations are assembled against Zion (wishing to defile her and gloat)
q: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”

s: nations do not know the LORD's thoughts (nor understand his counsel)
q: But they don’t know the thoughts of the LORD, neither do they understand his counsel;

s: Zion will receive iron horn and bronze hoofs (given by the LORD to thresh many peoples)
q: for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze.

s: the LORD is called Lord of the whole earth
q: their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.

s: nations will stream to mountain of the LORD's temple (peoples in the latter days)
q: and peoples will stream to it.

s: nations will learn ways of the LORD (many nations will go up to be taught)
q: he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.

s: the LORD will judge nations (between many peoples and strong nations afar off)
q: he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off.

s: Zion is source of law (the law will go out of Zion)
q: For the law will go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem;

s: Jerusalem is source of the LORD's word (will go out from Jerusalem)
q: the LORD’s word from Jerusalem;

s: swords and spears turned to farming tools are made from swords and spears (beaten into plowshares and pruning hooks)
q: They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks.

s: war will not be learned by nations (in the latter days)
q: Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

s: Bethlehem Ephrathah is a clan of Judah (small)
q: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah

s: Israel has judge judge of Israel (to be struck on the cheek with a rod)
q: They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

s: Israel is besieged by enemies
q: He has laid siege against us.

s: Israel is called daughter of troops
q: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops.

s: the LORD abandons Israel (until she who is in labor gives birth)
q: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth.

s: the LORD will destroy idolatry and witchcraft (including engraved images, pillars, Asherah poles, soothsayers)
q: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.

s: the LORD will execute vengeance on nations (those that didn't listen)
q: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”

s: Assyria has land land of Nimrod (ruled by Israel's leaders with the sword)
q: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates.

s: remnant of Jacob is located among many peoples (like dew from the LORD)
q: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass

s: remnant of Jacob is like lion (among the nations, treading down and tearing in pieces)
q: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest

s: remnant of Jacob returns to children of Israel (the rest of his brothers)
q: Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

s: Bethlehem Ephrathah has size small (among the clans of Judah)
q: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah

s: Bethlehem Ephrathah produces ruler in Israel (will come out for the LORD)
q: out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel

s: ruler in Israel has origin ancient times (goings out are from of old)
q: whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.

s: ruler in Israel shepherds in strength of the LORD (manner of ruling)
q: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God.

s: ruler in Israel has god the LORD
q: in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God.

s: ruler in Israel has greatness great to the ends of the earth
q: for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

s: ruler in Israel is our peace
q: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land

s: ruler in Israel delivers from Assyria (when it invades the land)
q: He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

s: the LORD has case against Israel (he will contend with Israel)
q: for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.

s: the LORD inflicts the LORD's punishment (grievous wound and desolation because of sins)
q: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.

s: the LORD's case against Israel has witness mountains and hills (the LORD's witnesses) (plead before them)
q: plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

s: the city has wisdom that fears the LORD's name
q: and wisdom fears your name

s: the city contains dishonest commerce (treasures of wickedness, short ephah, deceitful weights)
q: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?

s: rich men of the city are full of violence (also speak lies)
q: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

s: the city follows Omri (keeps his statutes)
q: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house.

s: the city follows Ahab (keeps the works of his house)
q: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house.

s: the LORD's punishment includes unsatisfying food (eat but not be satisfied)
q: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you.

s: the LORD's punishment includes fruitless labor (sow but not reap; no oil or wine)
q: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.

s: the LORD's punishment includes ruin and reproach (city a ruin, inhabitants a hissing)
q: that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”

s: the LORD brought up out of Egypt (redeemed Israel from bondage)
q: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage.

s: the LORD sent before israel Moses (leader sent before the people)
q: I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

s: the LORD sent before israel Aaron (leader sent before the people)
q: I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

s: the LORD sent before israel Miriam (leader sent before the people)
q: I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

s: the LORD requires what the LORD requires (justice, mercy, humility) (of man)
q: What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

s: the LORD has witnesses mountains and hills (the LORD's witnesses) (called to hear his indictment)
q: Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth;

s: the LORD calls to the city (his voice calls to it)
q: The LORD’s voice calls to the city

s: the LORD has relationship with Israel (Israel is his people)
q: My people, what have I done to you?

s: Micah of Morasheth expresses hope in the LORD (waits for him as God of salvation)
q: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation.
